mushroom:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Unity 2D cutout rig parts atlas. Reference Image 1 is the mushroom spear character to decompose and redraw for articulated animation. Preserve its identity, coral spotted mushroom head, cream face, olive tunic, belt, brown boots, warm thick outlines. Change ONLY its presentation into separate fully drawn animation parts, including surfaces previously hidden by overlaps.
Output one SQUARE transparent RGBA atlas with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows of equal square cells. Each of the 16 cells has ONE isolated asset centered with 15% empty padding. NO assembled character, NO words, NO labels, NO grid lines. All unused pixels transparent. All limbs vertical, shoulder/hip at TOP, hand/foot at BOTTOM. Parts must never touch a cell boundary or each other.
Read left to right, top to bottom:
row 1: [whole mushroom cap and face/head ONLY with small neck, no collar/body] [olive tunic torso ONLY with collar buckle belt hem, no head/arms/legs] [back upper arm olive short sleeve capsule] [back forearm cream mitten hand and short bare wrist ONLY, no weapon]
row 2: [front upper arm olive short sleeve capsule] [front forearm cream mitten hand and short bare wrist ONLY, no weapon] [back thigh brown shorts capsule] [back shin and brown boot]
row 3: [front thigh brown shorts capsule] [front shin and brown boot] [complete tall thin wooden spear with stone tip, UPRIGHT tip at top, NO HAND] [small olive leaf buckler, no hand]
row 4: [ivory narrow horizontal thrust speed slash effect pointing right] [gold star-shaped impact burst] [small pale spore projectile pointing right] [three pale dust puff shapes grouped as one small effect]
Draw every body part completely to allow overlap at joints. Keep compact simple rounded cutout aesthetic with flat color and just one shade. No scenery or ground shadow. Each cell independent, consistent line weight. The limbs may be larger than final assembly: each will be resized separately in Unity. Critical: exactly 4x4 separate components, not character pose variations.
